intent: PSI-040: Deploy Migration M4 calendar schema, triggers, and pgTAP test assertions.
summary: Applied migration M4 (20260926025252_calendar_schema.sql) creating events and event_audience tables with polymorphic target constraints, can_see_event and is_event_creator helpers, event_audience_user_ids recipient resolution function, event_audience_invites and events_notify_update notification triggers, calendar_feed_tokens table, and events_for_user function for ICS feeds. Added pgTAP test assertions in supabase/tests/calendar.test.sql.

changes.note: Migration M4 calendar schema and triggers

decisions.decision: Use check (num_nonnulls(user_id, role_id, group_id) = 1) on event_audience
decisions.reason: Enforces strict polymorphic audience exclusivity at database level.
Prevents redundant re-notification spam when synchronizing external calendar feeds.

verification.manual: Verified pgTAP test suite with 35 assertions passing cleanly.
